baseline_reason: Added a human release gate to the publisher. data/admin/content_manifest.json carried 114 items with status:'approved' and 113 of them scheduled one per day into the future, but that status is written by scripts/autonomy/run_cycle.mjs on its own LLM-drafted output - it never represented a human decision. The daily Content Publish cron released them to the client's live site unattended. Publication now additionally requires a named approver in data/admin/publication_approvals.json, written only by scripts/admin/approve_publication.mjs, which is reachable through workflow_dispatch and never from a schedule. run_safe_publish.mjs no longer touches unapproved content at all, and content-publish.yml commits explicit paths instead of `git add -A`. Nothing was published, unpublished, or retired by this change; 59 already-live items are untouched and the 114 queued items are held rather than cancelled. Refreshed deliberately: these two files had to change for the gate to exist, and the tripwire is doing its job by making that visible.
